service_name: CM Helpline (181) — General Civic Grievance Channel
sub_service: Garbage, water, road, and streetlight complaints routed via the state-wide CM Helpline
problem_type: General civic complaints (garbage, water, roads, streetlights) routed through the state grievance system
department: CM Helpline, Government of Madhya Pradesh
authority: CM Helpline call center; forwarded to the relevant department officer
description: Madhya Pradesh's state-wide CM Helpline (181) is confirmed real and operating 7:30am-11pm daily; its own About page states complaints are forwarded to the concerned department's officer for resolution (Hindi: 'निराकरण हेतु संबंधित विभाग के अधिकारी को शिकायत प्रेषित की जाती है'). This is a general, state-wide mechanism covering all municipal complaint types (not a city- or category-specific charter) -- filed once under WASTE_SANITATION since that's the most common civic-complaint type routed through it, but the underlying channel applies to water, road, and streetlight complaints in Madhya Pradesh's cities equally.
procedure: Call 181 or use the CM Helpline portal; the complaint is forwarded to the relevant department's officer for resolution.
sla: SLA NOT FOUND -- no escalation levels or numeric response/resolution time are published on this specific page.
escalation_procedure: NOT FOUND IN OFFICIAL SOURCE on this page -- only that complaints are forwarded to the relevant department officer.
